name: octoforge
description: Home of a family of self-hosted GitHub tools: an index with live status, a GitHub credentials helper and a shared database host.

scripts.build: bun run --filter @octoforge/shared build && bun run --filter @octoforge/web build && bun run --filter @octoforge/server build
scripts.lint: biome check packages biome.json package.json tsconfig.base.json
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write packages biome.json package.json tsconfig.base.json
